notes.title: Grades 2 / 3 Preliminary Release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, Looh here with an update (finally!).

In this update you'll find Grades 2 and 3 are available. Most of Grade 2 and all of Grade 3 do not have vocabulary options at this time. You'll see a lock icon on the "Vocab" button in lessons only on lessons that don't have any vocabulary to study. I'm being a bit picky about which words I pick and choose from, and it created such an unnecessary mental block that kept me from designing levels and such. So, I decided to just release an update with the Kanji only!

Some bugs have been fixed, but as always, since this game is still in early access, there will still be bugs. Please join the Kanji RPG discord and follow my Kanji RPG twitter for updates and to discuss any bugs!

notes.title: Launch & Day 1 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Thanks everyone who bought the game day 1! I'm grateful for people who pointed out some bugs right away, and they have been fixed:

* Dying in the HIragana/Katakana mode is no longer a softlock (woops!)
* Fixed an issue relating to spam clicking buttons
